welcome.text: Tap the golden stars! They follow the skip counting pattern!

instructions.text: Red stars are wrong — don't tap them! Golden stars are right!

correct_1.text: Great catch! You found the right number!

correct_2.text: You got it! Perfect skip counting!

correct_3.text: Nice grab! You really know your numbers!

correct_4.text: Amazing! You found the right star!

wrong_1.text: Oops! That's not in the pattern. Watch out!

wrong_2.text: Not quite! That star doesn't belong. Be careful!

wrong_3.text: Wrong star! Look for the next number in the pattern!

encouragement_2.text: Awesome work! You're a skip counting star!

win.text: You counted all the way! What a champion!

try_again.text: Good effort! Let's try counting again!
